subject.callable: _downcast_to_mxfp with E5M2 values, E8M0 scales and ROUND_DOWN
subject.boundary: one launch converts all four rows and both 32-element blocks per row, writing complete element and scale tensors

program_reference.basis: The selected task is itself a discrete scale and element conversion, so the program comparison must retain the declared conversion rounding.

tasks.task_statement: Convert the complete contiguous float32 [4,64] input to non-swizzled E5M2 MXFP8 using final-axis blocks of32 and the FLOOR scale rule, returning every numerical element and every E8M0 code.

input_map.basis: the wrapper requires physical float32 input
the output tensor has Triton float8e5 element type
MICROBLOCK is fixed to32 and the final dimension is split into two blocks
rounding mode argument1 selects ROUND_DOWN, the same exponent-floor task
the output scale tensor has ordinary row-major shape [4,2]
